text: Anti-Money Laundering (AML) Solutions: software and services for detecting, preventing, and reporting financial crimes and suspicious transactions; AML; Anti-Money Laundering; KYC; Know Your Customer; CFT; Combating the Financing of Terrorism; transaction monitoring; sanctions screening; financial crime compliance; AML software; AML platform; AML consulting
reasons: AML tenders are typically filed under broad IT or consultancy categories rather than a specific 'AML' category, so no clear GeM category fit exists; extra terms like KYC and CFT are added because they are frequently used interchangeably or alongside AML in tender titles.
